raw: {"verdict": "fail", "reason": "The patch only changes the wizard UI and the admin calendar. The server-side booking API is untouched, so nothing trims the note, stores empty or whitespace-only notes as NULL, saves the note on the booking, or rejects notes over 500 characters with 400 bad_request (maxLength on the textarea does not protect the public API). The wizard also sends the note, but the API never persists it."}
